abstract: Conversational recommender systems often treat user sessions in isolation, limiting their ability to capture how user intent evolves over time. While large language models (LLMs) have improved semantic understanding, they are typically used as isolated components, without addressing how memory, retrieval, and decision-making should be integrated at the system level. In this work, we propose a memory-aware multi-agent architecture for conversational recommendation, in which LLMs act as orchestration layers that coordinate intent refinement, query construction, and interaction flow. A key design principle is the integration of long-term memory as a first-class component, influencing both routing decisions and semantic query formation. We evaluate the system through cross-session memory experiments, multi-turn conversational simulations, and supervisor-driven interaction studies on the Amazon Reviews dataset. Results show that memory-enabled interactions recover up to 63\% of the gap toward explicit-query scenarios and prevent semantic degradation in extended dialogues. In addition, supervisory orchestration increases user acceptance by +28.9 percentage points, highlighting the importance of structured orchestration in guiding interaction and output quality. We also observe an exposure bottleneck between retrieved candidates and displayed recommendations. While LLM-reranking does not improve Hit@K, it consistently enhances semantic consistency and diversity. To capture these effects, we introduce the Semantic Consistency Score (SCS), a complementary evaluation measure. Overall, the results emphasize the importance of system-level design choices, suggesting that effective conversational recommendation benefits from explicit memory integration, orchestration, and evaluation beyond traditional ranking metrics. business_implications_zh: 跨会话长期记忆可提升对话推荐对用户意图演化的捕捉能力，适合需要连续服务体验的业务场景。
结构化监督编排可能显著提升用户接受度，可用于客服、导购等对话式推荐流程设计。
评估不应只看Hit@K等排序指标，还应关注语义一致性与多样性。
需关注检索候选到展示推荐之间的曝光瓶颈，优化候选展示与过滤机制。
LLM重排序更适合作为语义质量与多样性优化手段，而非必然提升命中率的排序手段。
contributions_zh: 提出面向对话推荐的记忆感知多智能体架构，由大语言模型作为编排层协调意图细化、查询构建与交互流程。
将长期记忆作为一等组件，使其同时影响路由决策与语义查询构建。
通过跨会话记忆实验、多轮对话模拟和监督式交互研究评估系统。
提出语义一致性得分（SCS）作为传统排序指标之外的补充评估指标。
揭示检索候选与展示推荐之间的曝光瓶颈，并发现LLM重排序不提升Hit@K但改善语义一致性与多样性。

findings_zh: 启用记忆的交互最多可恢复63%的向显式查询场景的差距，并在扩展对话中防止语义退化。
监督式编排使用户接受度提升28.9个百分点。
存在检索候选与展示推荐之间的曝光瓶颈。
LLM重排序不提升Hit@K，但持续增强语义一致性与多样性。
metrics: 向显式查询场景差距的恢复比例

limitations_zh: 仅基于摘要分析，缺少完整方法、实验设置与统计细节。
摘要未明确列出对比基线。
实验仅提及Amazon Reviews数据集，跨领域泛化证据有限。
SCS为论文新提出的补充指标，摘要未给出其充分验证细节。
deep_reading.method_zh: 采用记忆感知的多智能体架构：大语言模型充当编排层，负责意图细化、查询构建和交互流程协调；长期记忆作为一等组件参与路由决策与语义查询形成，并通过监督式编排引导交互与输出质量。
deep_reading.problem_zh: 对话推荐系统通常将会话孤立处理，难以捕捉用户意图随时间的变化；大语言模型虽提升语义理解，但多以孤立组件使用，未在系统层面整合记忆、检索与决策。

summary_zh: 该文提出面向对话推荐的内存感知多智能体架构，以 LLM 作为编排层并集成长期记忆，实验显示记忆机制与监督编排显著提升交互效果与语义一致性。
title: Memory-Aware Multi-Agent Architecture with LLM-based Orchestration for Conversational Recommendation
